title: Pinched cylinder with end diaphragms
description: Cylinder (R = 300, L = 600, t = 3, E = 3e6, nu = 0.3) with rigid end diaphragms, pinched by two opposite unit loads at mid-length. One octant is modeled.
source: MacNeal & Harder, 'A proposed standard set of problems to test finite element accuracy', Finite Elements in Analysis and Design 1 (1985) 3-20; Belytschko, Stolarski, Liu, Carpenter & Ong, CMAME 51 (1985) 221-258; reference 1.8248e-5.

checks.label: Displacement under the load, 32 x 32 quadrilaterals
